_README: The GTM MCP connector, ready to merge into .claude-plugin/plugin.json the day GTM MCP launches, with the real URL in place of GTM_MCP_URL_ASSIGNED_AT_LAUNCH. It is NOT in plugin.json yet: shipping it before the server exists would have every installed copy prompt for a key it cannot use and fail to connect on every start. See references/gtm-mcp.md. tests/test_gtm_mcp_connector.py checks this block against the plugin manifest rules.

gtm_mcp_key.title: GTM MCP key
gtm_mcp_key.description: The key from your GTM OS onboarding. Claude Code stores it in your system keychain, not in any file.
